title: V5 migration fails on databases with existing duplicate sender_msg_id rows
description: The V5 migration does CREATE UNIQUE INDEX on (chat_id, sender_msg_id). If a V4 database has duplicate rows from retransmission (the bug KITH-orvy.3 was fixing), the migration fails and kithd fails to start. No deduplication step precedes the CREATE UNIQUE INDEX. Fix: add DELETE FROM messages WHERE rowid NOT IN (SELECT MIN(rowid) FROM messages GROUP BY chat_id, sender_msg_id) before the DROP INDEX, or document that V4 databases with duplicates require manual cleanup.
